title: content/recipes.yaml — craft recipes mediating the single Craft atomic action (D3/D4/D10)
description: The recipe catalog (Materials & Crafting plan §0 locked). A recipe is DATA, not a hand-drawn plan: Craft is ONE atomic action (D3) parameterized by a recipe; the planner chains gather→craft itself (never authored). Inputs are TAG QUERIES, not specific item ids — an input requires a tag SET (e.g. `shaft_stock`) at a quantity, so substitutability EMERGES from tags (D4): any item_kind carrying the queried tags is a valid input, and a new item becomes eligible by carrying the tag (no recipe edit). Tools are non-consumed durables matched by tag; the §6 capability multiplier reading the held tool's tags lives in the Craft action's Formula, NOT here (plan §0). platform/config compiles this into the recipe registry and cross-checks that every `outputs[].item` is a known item_kind and every input `tagQuery`/`tool` tag is referenced by at least one item_kind's `tags` (an unreachable recipe is a load-time WARNING/failure, D10). Quality/yield (Dexterity → chance/qty) reuses the flora yield model in the Craft action, NOT a per-recipe field.

recipes.description: The recipe table. An empty array = no craftables (outcome-neutral introduction). Order is NOT significant (recipes are matched by tag-query availability, deterministically by sorted recipe id in the planner/Craft action).

tag.description: A core.Tag identifier (material tag like `shaft_stock`, tool tag like `tool:cutting`, or station tag). Must match the glossary/tag vocabulary; cross-checked at load (D10).

tagQuery.description: The set of tags an INPUT item_kind must ALL carry to satisfy this slot (AND over the set — substitutability emerges from tags, plan §0/D4). Any item_kind whose `tags` is a superset of this set is a valid input; the actor/planner picks among them. An empty set is a load failure (an input must constrain something).

input.description: One required input slot: a tag-query that the consumed item must satisfy, at a quantity. NOT a specific item id (D4 — substitutability via tags).

qty.description: Number of items satisfying tagQuery consumed by one craft. Integer >= 1.

output.description: One produced item: a concrete item_kind id at a base quantity. The actual rolled qty/quality scales by §6(Dexterity) in the Craft action (flora yield model reuse, plan §0), NOT here — `qty` is the base amount before that scaling.

qty.description: Base produced quantity per craft (integer >= 1). Dexterity-driven quality/qty scaling is applied by the Craft action via §6, reusing the flora yield roll.

inputs.description: Required input slots (tag-query + qty each). minItems 1 — a recipe consumes something.

outputs.description: Produced items (item + base qty each). minItems 1 — a recipe produces something.

tool.description: Optional REQUIRED tool tag: the actor must hold an item_kind carrying this tag for the craft to be visible/possible. The tool is a non-consumed durable (`wear`, plan §0) — its `wear` decrement + the §6 capability multiplier reading the held tool's tags live in the Craft action, NOT in the recipe.

station.description: Optional REQUIRED station tag: the actor must be at an object_kind carrying this tag (e.g. tool_bench → `station:bench`) for the craft. Like `tool`, the station is referenced by tag (D4); the at-station gate is enforced by the Craft action/planner.
